newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish banks' H1 results up FIM 3.6 billion yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish banks' H1 results up FIM 3.6 billion yr/yr.

text.p: The aggregate operating result after credit losses of Finnish banks improved by 3.6 billion markka year-on-year in January-June to a 1.5 billion markka profit, the Finnish Bankers' Association said on Friday.
Aggregate credit losses declined by about two billion markka in the first half to some two billion compared to the year-ago period, the association said in a statement.

Aggregate net income from financial operations narrowed due both to "rather quiet credit demand" and banks' lower interest rate margins. The H1 total was about 5.5 billion markka, down from slightly above six billion in the year-ago period.

The figures comprised banking groups Merita Oy, the cooperative banks around OKOBANK, state-owned Postipankki Oy, state-controlled SKOPBank, independent savings banks, Alandsbanken AB and Interbank Oy, the association said.
